title: Rust CCP beacon vector consumer assumes hash fields on every slot-selection case
description: rust/lichen-node/tests/ccp_beacon_format.rs iterates every type=slot_selection vector and unwraps output.hash_32, but canonical EMA/timing slot-selection cases legitimately omit EUI/hash metadata. This panics after vector regeneration. Filter production slot-hash assertions to cases with the required eui64/slot fields and only assert hash_32 when the vector supplies that oracle; require at least one consumed canonical case.
